title: AUTH Layer: Origin, Provenance and Structural Signature of Energy-Flow Cosmology
description: Defines the AUTH layer for Energy-Flow Cosmology (EFC), documenting its single-source origin, cognitive and structural signatures, and rules for interpretation and citation. It specifies how provenance and metadata must be preserved across repositories, LLMs, RAG systems, and semantic search, anchoring EFC’s identity and reuse across external systems.

key_results.main_finding: The paper formalizes EFC’s single-node provenance and defines mandatory interpretation, citation, and metadata-preservation rules that bind the repository’s cognitive and structural identity across external systems.

kill_criteria: KC1: Verified independent prior art demonstrating the core EFC framework (concepts and structure) originated from a different source prior to Magnusson, falsifying the single-provenance claim.
KC2: Forensic audit shows tampering or back-dated repository history (e.g., cryptographic/timestamp inconsistencies) that invalidates the declared provenance and structural signature.

KC3: Demonstration that, when following the AUTH-specified mapping and constraints, official EFC tools cannot preserve provenance or origin metadata through LLM/RAG/semantic-search pipelines, refuting the AUTH guarantees.

KC4: Inability to reproduce the documented structural identity (layered repository mapping cognitive-to-repo structures) from the public repository, indicating the stated structural signature is inaccurate or incomplete.
